input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties or early-termination fee on the Client. Termination (§14) requires only that services continue, and fees be paid, through the last day of the month following notice — no fixed damages or minimum payout is triggered. Compensation (§5) contains only ordinary monthly fees for services actually requested (with blank minimum monthly amounts payable during the term, not on termination) and no late-payment penalty or fixed damages; the unsolicited e-mail covenant (§7) prohibits spamming but attaches no per-message charge or penalty to Client. This meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties), so no redline is warranted. We note the minimum monthly fee blanks in §5a and the fact that they are excluded from Client's dispute rights in §6 as commercial points to complete, but they are not liquidated damages.
